description: This file defines memory management functions and related constants for the Starboard platform, including allocation, deallocation, memory mapping, and protection. It also includes documentation and deprecation notes for various functions.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of at least the specified size, similar to malloc.

methods.name: SbMemoryReallocate
methods.description: Resizes a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateAligned
methods.description: Allocates memory aligned to a specified boundary.

methods.name: SbMemoryDeallocate
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: SbMemoryMap
methods.description: Maps physical memory pages into virtual address space with specified flags.

methods.name: SbMemoryProtect
methods.description: Changes protection flags for a memory region.

methods.name: SbMemoryFlush
methods.description: Flushes CPU caches for a memory region (executable memory).

methods.name: SbMemoryGetStackBounds
methods.description: Retrieves the stack bounds for the current thread.
